optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fleet Analytics Analyst, Waste Collection Services

professionalSummary.text: Three‑year Fleet Analytics Analyst with proven expertise in analysing telematics and tipping data across eleven depots, proposing data‑driven round changes, and delivering monthly contract performance reports.
professionalSummary.witness: Fleet analytics analyst at a waste collection company for three years, analysing the round telematics and tipping data for the company's eleven depots under the team's analysis procedure.

professionalSummary.text: Successfully proposed 34 round changes with documented mileage and time savings, securing approvals from the operations director and validating outcomes through post‑change telematics.
professionalSummary.witness: Proposed thirty‑four round changes with their expected mileage and time effects; the approvals were the operations director's, recorded on each proposal, and the post‑change telematics confirmed the expected effect within the tolerance on twenty‑nine of them.

professionalSummary.text: Delivered monthly contract performance reports to contract managers, following the established template and filing procedures.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers under the report template, filed in the contracts folder.

professionalSummary.text: Presented round changes to depot managers, documented objections and resolutions, and ensured hand‑over conditions were clearly recorded.
professionalSummary.witness: Presented each round change to the depot manager concerned in the depot review, with the depot review record listing the manager's objections and how each was resolved or carried to the director.

experienceHighlights.text: Analyzed telematics and tipping data for 11 depots, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for route optimization.
experienceHighlights.witness: analysing the round telematics and tipping data for the company's eleven depots under the team's analysis procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored 34 round change proposals, each with quantified mileage and time savings, and tracked post‑implementation performance.
experienceHighlights.witness: Proposed thirty‑four round changes with their expected mileage and time effects; the approvals were the operations director's, recorded on each proposal, and the post‑change telematics confirmed the expected effect within the tolerance on twenty‑nine of them.

experienceHighlights.text: Compiled and filed monthly contract performance reports, ensuring alignment with contractual reporting standards.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers under the report template, filed in the contracts folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Facilitated depot review meetings, capturing objections and resolutions, and maintained comprehensive change documentation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented each round change to the depot manager concerned in the depot review, with the depot review record listing the manager's objections and how each was resolved or carried to the director.
